name: security-radar
description: Security Radar: automated dependency vulnerability monitoring. Reads maintainers' security advisories the minute they publish, checks every listed lockfile, tiers every finding, lets Claude decide per project what is worth fixing, and posts one Slack message per project.

scripts.test: node --test test/semver.test.mjs test/advisories.test.mjs test/lockfile.test.mjs test/feeds.test.mjs test/report.test.mjs test/osv.test.mjs test/slack.test.mjs test/scope.test.mjs test/filter.test.mjs test/history.test.mjs
